claim: Instantiate actual native derived-presentation comparisons and compositions with one comparison input retaining all four validated PN port records and separate typed permits, complete checked PN-target field bindings, lift/route incidence records and observation-support contexts.
policy: The admitted parent is exactly the frozen complete comparison input. A view selects one already retained port and its permit; it does not manufacture a permit for an ineligible chart. Numerical matrices and source histories are literal retained data, not interpreted Agda field operators. The parent is a comparison context, not a jointly occupied state.
controls: all four source ports and typed permits retained
16 native view comparisons and64 compositions instantiated
removing the contextual payload cannot satisfy the parent admission predicate
generated literals match live checked source artifacts
boundary: Source-bound derived-view admission only. No kernel interpretation of field matrices, role-changing physical action, or semantic field/incidence restriction follows from literal retention.
stop_condition: Fresh safe Cubical concrete admission/composition and hostile rejection, or first failed binding.
